samples.question: The page shows exactly one trail of small dark beads. All dark marks belong to that single trail; every pale grey mark is clutter and must be ignored. One end of the trail is a filled dark square and the other end is a larger dark round blob. Walk along the trail bead by bead, starting at the square end and finishing at the round end. At each bead the walk turns; count a turn that bends counter-clockwise on the page as positive degrees and a turn that bends clockwise as negative degrees, and add up every turn of the whole walk. Individual stretches turn both ways, so only the total over the entire trail decides the answer. Is the total counter-clockwise or clockwise? Answer counterclockwise or clockwise.
